m0-context.title: Load baseline context and map seams
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT, ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT, GLOSSARY, the g2 handoff, and map the four seams (module_training_orchestration, runtime_normalization, run_season_alignment/extract_race_observations, gold_cycle/config). Confirm handoff completeness and that recent-history form/labels are strictly backward-looking. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: context + handoff loaded; handoff complete; seams mapped; form/label path confirmed backward-looking (prior_rounds=range(1,round_num))
postconditions.satisfied_by: CREW/ORCH/GLOSSARY/handoff read; 4 seams mapped at file:line; form+labels confirmed backward-looking (prior_rounds=range(1,round_num))

m1-evalsplit.title: Eval-year split primitive (train-through-round-N + eval round range)
m1-evalsplit.imperative: TDD. Write tests/unit/evo_predictor/walkforward/test_as_of_cutoff.py FIRST (red). Add a per-year round-window filter to build_labeled_batches_for_module (sibling to gp_name_filter) and explicit eval_year_train_through_round + eval_round_range params to prepare_module_training_data, threaded so TRAIN = train_years(all rounds) + eval_year rounds<=N and EVAL = eval_year rounds in target range. Gold defaults (params None) byte-for-byte unchanged. Make red test green.

postconditions.statement: leakage-invariant test green: every train event (year<eval_year) or (year==eval_year and round<=N); every eval event year==eval_year and round in target_range; no train event year==eval_year and round>N; form/label backward-looking asserted

constraints: one canonical opt-in path; no parallel assembly fork
gold defaults unchanged when params None
validate new public params naming field/expectation/actual

m2-asof-prior.title: As-of-N compound prior build path (DB-only) + named load
m2-asof-prior.imperative: TDD. Add a through_round cap to run_season_alignment.run_year (drives extract_race_observations with rounds 1..N instead of --all) so the built prior's selected_source_races are all round<=N; rounds>N physically absent from inputs. Keep the as-of load explicit/named (the existing allow_same_season_research path, used ONLY when genuinely as-of-N). Do NOT loosen the gold-mode same-season guard. Add tests asserting no round>N contributes and DB-only (skip_collection path).

postconditions.statement: as-of-N prior build/test green: a through_round=N build yields selected_source_races all round<=N; no round>N contributes; gold same-season guard untouched

constraints: do not loosen gold-mode same-season guard

m3-config.title: Config plumbing for cutoff (gold default unchanged)
m3-config.imperative: Expose the in-season cutoff in gold_cycle/config.py following existing validation patterns (optional field; gold default = no cutoff = None). Add validation naming field/expectation/actual. Add a test that gold default profile is unchanged (no cutoff) and that a research/smoke profile can set it.

postconditions.statement: config test green: cutoff field optional, gold default None/unchanged, research can set; existing gold_cycle_config tests still pass

m4-verify.title: Full verification + regression + simplification_limits
m4-verify.imperative: Run all required evidence commands and capture real output: the new test, the two regression suites (test_multi_season, test_gold_cycle_config), and simplification_limits on touched paths.

postconditions.statement: simplification_limits passes on touched src/ and tests/ paths
